# Doc Style Guide

Use this checklist to keep documentation consistent.

## Naming
- Keep files in `docs/`.
- Use kebab-case file names.
- Use short, clear, topic-based names.

## Structure
- Start with one H1 title.
- Include an Overview section.
- Use ordered steps for procedures.
- Add Validation and Troubleshooting for how-to pages.
- End with Related Docs links when applicable.

## Writing
- Use direct, active voice.
- Keep sentences short and concrete.
- Prefer examples over abstract guidance.
- Define acronyms the first time they appear.

## Commands And Paths
- Wrap commands and paths in backticks.
- Provide complete command examples when possible.
- Avoid placeholders unless they are clearly labeled.

## Quality Gate
- Steps are executable as written.
- Expected outcomes are stated.
- No contradictory instructions.
- Links resolve to existing files.
